author: BigIronGaming
quote:
There are minor changes to dialogue and gameplay that I don't care for, but they don't take away from the experience, they're just different from the n64 and 3ds versions I'm used to.

Ocarina of Time remains one of the greatest RPG's of all time. Whether its boss design, dungeon layout, or story pacing, Nintendo nailed it 30 years ago, and they've only improved upon it with time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: BigIronGaming
